ddl:
-- ClickHouse-native DDL for the http_logs dataset.
--
-- Derived from the OpenSearch http_logs index mapping (http_logs/index.json).
-- Source dataset: 1998 FIFA World Cup web server logs
-- (http://ita.ee.lbl.gov/html/contrib/WorldCup.html).
--
-- Field mapping (OS -> CH):
--   @timestamp     date              -> DateTime64(3)
--   clientip       ip                -> String
--   request        text              -> String
--   status         integer           -> Int32
--   size           integer           -> Int32
--   message        keyword (index=false, doc_values=false) -> String, optional
--
-- The geoip.* sub-fields and ingest-pipeline-only fields are descoped for v1
-- since they are populated by OS ingest pipelines (geoip / grok) not present
-- in the base corpus. Bulk INSERTs go through JSONEachRow with
-- input_format_skip_unknown_fields=1, so any extra fields in the corpus
-- (e.g. geoip object) are silently ignored.
--
-- Ordering: (status, @timestamp) matches the workload's most common query
-- shapes -- status=200/400 filters combined with @timestamp range, plus
-- @timestamp sorts and hourly date_histogram aggregations.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS http_logs
(
    `@timestamp` DateTime64(3) NOT NULL,
    clientip String NOT NULL,
    request String NOT NULL,
    status Int32 NOT NULL,
    size Int32 NOT NULL,
    message String DEFAULT ''
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (status, `@timestamp`);
